projectDescription: A decentralized, privacy-first instant messenger for Android that works over email infrastructure with end-to-end encryption, group chats, voice/video calls, and extensible in-chat apps (Webxdc).
keyFeatures: Decentralized messaging over email infrastructure — no central servers
End-to-end encryption (Autocrypt / OpenPGP) for all messages
Voice and video calls via WebRTC
Group chats, broadcast channels, and mailing list support
Webxdc in-chat apps (shopping lists, games, calendars, etc.)
Multiple independent chat profiles on a single device
QR-code based contact verification and device pairing
Works with any email provider or self-hosted server
publicApiSurface: DcContext — core context managing messages, contacts, chats
DcChat — chat object (single, group, broadcast, mailing list)
DcMsg — message object with type, state, and metadata
DcEvent / DC_EVENT_* constants — event system for UI updates
Rpc (JSON-RPC) — high-level async API over deltachat-core
RPC types: Account, FullChat, Message, Contact, TransportListEntry, WebxdcMessageInfo, etc.
DcContext.DC_QR_* constants — QR code action codes
